output.summary: Group ticket time rose by about 4 minutes in every location in October 2024, matching the board-approved 'Made Here' redesign and its station study, so the 17-18 minute level is a knowingly accepted tradeoff, not kitchen underperformance. Guest satisfaction rose after the redesign, so long tickets are not eroding it. Riverside's rise is localized to the saute/pasta station after an unfilled line position, and restoring that staffing is supported under every live explanation. Why the cook left remains unknown: the exit interview is missing and accounts conflict. Standardizing on par-cooked components would reverse a deliberate strategy and the failed trial lowered food quality. A 12-minute bonus target would reward gaming, given the 2023 bumping audit. Riverside's GM should not be replaced on unconfirmed evidence.
